script_text: Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now. For those committed, a miscommunication with your partner is brewing in the 7th House—listen more than you speak. On the career front, your 10th House is lit by a Venus-Jupiter conjunction, opening a door to a high-stakes opportunity you’ve been praying for. Avoid making impulsive decisions with your finances today—stability is your strength. Follow for tomorrow’s reading and don’t miss what the stars are plotting next.
